name: HoldPlaced
doc: Business payload only (ADR-IC-002); the CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. An authorization was approved and its funds earmarked (ADR-PC-033 / ADR-PC-030 stage 5): from this fact's sequence forward the hold is ACTIVE and lowers the account's available balance. DORMANT wire shape (the .avsc.json posture, like _shared/Movement.avsc.json): the event is STORE-ONLY today (ADR-IC-017 — no named external consumer), so this file is deliberately outside the *.avsc catalog/embed/compat globs; bus promotion is renaming to .avsc plus the AsyncAPI catalog entry and shape-lock, with the first named consumer. Field names follow the engine codec convention (Money Amount -> amount_cents etc.) so promotion is a rename, not a reshape. No PII (ADR-PC-004): hold_id and account_ref are opaque structural references, never an IBAN.

fields.name: instance_id
fields.doc: The account-owning instance (stream) the hold rides — a structural id, not PII.

fields.name: hold_id
fields.doc: The hold's lifecycle dedup/correlation key (ADR-PC-033) — every later capture/expiry carries it.

fields.name: account_ref
fields.doc: The opaque account whose available balance the earmark reduces — a reference, never PII.

fields.name: amount_cents
fields.doc: The earmarked amount in integer cents (ADR-PC-010).

fields.name: value_date
fields.doc: The economic date the hold takes effect — command-supplied, never a clock read.
